notes: Articles appear correctly in memorized chunks like 'a meeting' and 'a report', but disappear when the noun is longer, e.g. 'was project architecture meeting'.
Speaks in fragments and adds the time word as a separate piece ('...meeting.' + 'yesterday.'); joining them into one sentence still needs prompting.
'an' is reduced to 'a' before vowel-initial nouns; words like an hour, an apple, an email give good repetition.
